theme_strategy: Hybrid Theme (Light Mode for Landing/Dashboard, Dark Mode for Video Editor). Ensures a professional 'Trust' feel for marketing and an 'Immersion' feel for the creator workspace.

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Organic Trust
rules: Never use pure black or pure white without purpose; always use off-tints (e.g., slate-50).
Buttons must use the primary color with a lighter hue on hover (hover:bg-indigo-600).
DO NOT use generic full-screen gradients. Use solid colors with localized glowing orbs for accentuation.

headings.rules: Tracking-tight on large headings (H1/H2). Never center align unless explicit visual balance demands it. Forbidden: Inter, Roboto, Space Grotesk.

body.rules: High legibility, leading-relaxed for long text, leading-normal for UI elements.

marketing.structure: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode A - Tetris Grid) for feature sections. Asymmetric layout, avoiding standard 3-column Bootstrap look.

dashboard.structure: High Density Grid (Mode B). 250px sidebar with a fluid main content area. Flat cards with 1px border and no shadows by default.

video_editor.structure: Absolute/Flex combinations to create non-scrolling workspace panels (Timeline at bottom, preview center, assets left, properties right). Use border-collapse style layouts with sharp 1px borders.

surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.header_nav: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (light), 1px border-b border-slate-200/50. NEVER transparent.
surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.cards: Neumorphism mix: Flat backgrounds with sharp 1px border-slate-200, hover translates -translate-y-1 with shadow-lg.
surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.editor_panels: Retro-Futurism / Technical look: Dark backgrounds (#18181B) with thin, high-contrast borders (#27272A).
surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for landing page CTAs to feel approachable. Sharp (rounded-md) for Dashboard/Editor tools to feel precise.

component_guidelines.forms: Use customized Shadcn UI primitives. Inputs must have clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500).
component_guidelines.modals_dropdowns: Shadcn UI. Add backdrop-blur-sm to modal overlays. Do NOT build from scratch.
component_guidelines.tables: Shadcn UI Table component for billing/admin panels. Ensure high contrast text on hover rows.
component_guidelines.video_player_mock: Aspect-video container with rounded-lg overflow-hidden, relative positioning, custom play button overlay in the center with backdrop-blur.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactables must transition smoothly (transition-colors duration-200).
motion_and_interactions.entrances: Staggered fade-in-up (Framer Motion) for lists and grids.
motion_and_interactions.editor_interactions: Micro-animations on timeline tools. Drag-and-drop visuals need visual scaling (scale-105) when dragging.

hero_background.description: Smooth blue gradient background for landing page hero section.
hero_background.placement: Landing page hero background (with opacity overlay)

editor_preview_mockup.description: Flat screen monitor displaying a video editing timeline.
editor_preview_mockup.placement: Landing page 'How it works' or Hero floating product preview

creator_target_audience.description: Young creator working indoors with laptop and camera.
creator_target_audience.placement: Features section or testimonials highlighting the target user

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet 4.5:1 ratio. Large text 3:1.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case, role-based (e.g., data-testid='generate-video-button').
accessibility.focus: Visible focus states for keyboard navigation on all inputs and buttons.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic AI slop. Create layered depth.
Avoid the center-everything disease. Use left-aligned dense layouts for data.
NEVER use generic placeholder URLs for images. Use the provided image URLs.
Incorporate Sonner (from shadcn) for all toast notifications.
Prioritize Shadcn/UI for logic-heavy components like Dropdowns, Datepickers, and Dialogs.
Include 'lucide-react' for all icons, keeping them consistent in weight.
